name: Going Commando weapon wheel
author: Henning Berge
description: Going Commando's weapon quick select in Ratchet & Clank, running Going Commando's own copied code: Triangle holds the world (Going Commando's pause, its letterbox bars, no freeze dialog) while the stick or the d-pad picks a weapon on the ring, a click on each change, Going Commando's ammo and name text under it; letting go of Triangle equips it. Ratchet & Clank's own ring, icons, names and slots, read from the game. With 'Pause while open' off, it opens over the running game as Going Commando's option does. Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.39 and the hook points rac1.level.update_play, rac1.freeze.update and rac1.freeze.draw (not in a release yet).

conflicts.reason: both replace the quick select (rac1.hud.quick_select.*) and pause the game while it is open, each its own way

settings.name: Pause while open
settings.description: Going Commando's option: the world holds while the quick select is open (its game mode 4). Off: it opens over the running game, from Ratchet & Clank's own Triangle.

settings.name: Click sound
settings.description: A sound as the selection moves, where Going Commando clicks. Ratchet & Clank has no UI click: it is the level's sound bank's first entry, the one a help message opens with.
